appraisal_events.evidence: le neveu de Mme de Villeparisis comprenait autrement bien certaines oeuvres que sa tante, et surtout avait quelque chose qui le mettait bien au-dessus de la plupart des gens du club
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator reports his grandmother's judgment that Saint-Loup understood certain works far better than his aunt and stood well above most men of his social club, a distinctly favorable comparison.

appraisal_events.evidence: Je pourrai vous en donner une, puisque ce genre d'architecture vous intéresse, dit-il à ma grand'mère.
appraisal_events.explanation: Amid his otherwise haughty tirade, Charlus singles out the grandmother personally, offering her a photograph because her interest matches his own taste, a small mark of favor and inclusion.

appraisal_events.evidence: Mais la maison est du même style que le Petit Trianon, dit Mme de Villeparisis, et Marie-Antoinette y a bien fait faire un jardin anglais.
appraisal_events.explanation: Her calm, factual correction closing the exchange gives her a quiet rhetorical composure that stands apart from Charlus's overheated tirade, an independent local gain even as it also undercuts him.

status_effects.explanation: He is favorably distinguished by his grandmother's assessment as more perceptive than his aunt and above most of his social circle.
She is personally singled out for a small gift and shared interest by Charlus, marking her as included in his selective favor.
Her measured factual correction of Charlus's outburst gives her quiet authority at the close of the exchange.
